### **Job Title**

Test / Integration Engineer I

### **Job Description**

**Test Integration Engineer I | Pune, India | Full-time**

If you are an experienced testing and integration professional who enjoys leading complex system validation activities and working directly with customers and multidisciplinary engineering teams, this is an opportunity to play a key role in delivering Vanderlande’s advanced automation solutions.

**Your Role**

As a Test Integration Engineer I, you will provide functional leadership for testing activities across the project lifecycle. You will own the overall testing strategy, coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams, lead customer test workshops, and ensure the system is ready for successful acceptance.

You will work closely with Project Leaders, Engineering teams, customers, and other stakeholders to ensure that testing activities are effectively planned, executed, and aligned with project requirements.

**What you will do / Key Responsibilities**

Test Strategy & Project Ownership

* Own and drive the testing strategy across the project lifecycle.
* Define and manage test approaches, test plans, test readiness criteria, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with project requirements, system specifications, and customer expectations.
* Lead operational scenario validation to ensure the system performs effectively under realistic operating conditions.
* Approve test readiness and ensure required prerequisites are in place before testing activities commence.
* Lead and coordinate FAT, IHT, SFT, SAT, and other system acceptance activities as applicable.
* Monitor overall testing progress and provide clear reporting to project leadership.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

* Lead customer test workshops and facilitate technical discussions related to system testing and acceptance.
* Act as the key testing interface between the customer and internal engineering teams.
* Present test results, issues, risks, and mitigation plans to relevant stakeholders.
* Manage expectations and ensure alignment between customer requirements and testing outcomes.
* Participate in engineering discussions, design reviews, and system-level technical meetings.

Multidisciplinary Integration

* Coordinate testing activities across software, controls, electrical, mechanical, simulation, and other engineering disciplines.
* Drive system integration activities and ensure interfaces between disciplines are properly validated.
* Coordinate resolution of complex cross-disciplinary defects and technical issues.
* Guide Test Integration Engineers and provide functional leadership to the testing team.
* Support and mentor junior engineers and promote consistent testing practices.

Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

* Identify testing-related project risks and support the development of mitigation and contingency plans.
* Drive defect investigations and ensure critical issues are followed through to resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, tools, methodologies, and system validation.
* Promote standardisation and reuse of test procedures and best practices across projects.
* Ensure complete and accurate test documentation and project handover deliverables.

**What you bring**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical, E&TC, or Computer Engineering.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in system integration, software testing, system testing, or a related engineering environment, with demonstrated experience in a testing or integration lead role.
* Strong understanding of software testing and development life cycles, including V-Model, CMMI, Agile, and test processes.
* Strong hands-on experience with Polarion, Jira, Oracle PL/SQL, and Unix.
* Strong experience in developing and reviewing test strategies, test plans, test cases, integration plans, system designs, and acceptance criteria.
* Proven ability to lead testing activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in leading defect investigations and technical issue resolution.
* Strong ownership, leadership, and mentoring capabilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively and support customer projects based on business requirements.
* Knowledge of airport baggage handling, material handling, distribution systems, PLC, and SCADA is highly advantageous.
* Previous experience in airport automation or a similar complex automation environment is an advantage.

**About Vanderlande**

Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey—from check-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to

customers’ doors. At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking an experienced **Siebel CRM application operations professional** to manage the day-to-day operational health and technical support of Oracle Siebel CRM and associated platforms from **SP Infocity, Pune**.

This hands-on role focuses on service stability, SLA adherence, major incident and problem resolution, proactive monitoring, technical troubleshooting, automation, operational governance and continual service improvement. You will act as a technical escalation point for complex production issues and work across Siebel CRM, Oracle BSS and connected technology teams.

You should bring **7–10 years of Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations experience**, including at least **5 years of hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience**. Working knowledge of SRE practices, observability and automation is important for improving reliability, service performance and operational efficiency.

**What you will do**
--------------------

### **Application support and technical operations**

* Manage day-to-day support and operational health of Oracle Siebel CRM services.
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex incidents, service degradation and cross-system issues.
* Coordinate P1/P2 incident triage, technical analysis, service restoration and timely stakeholder communication.
* Perform detailed troubleshooting using Siebel logs, workflow and component analysis, Oracle SQL, Unix/Linux utilities and monitoring data.
* Coordinate end-to-end diagnosis across FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, database, infrastructure and network teams.

### **SLA, service management and governance**

* Track adherence to agreed incident response, restoration and service request SLAs.
* Review service KPIs including availability, SLA compliance, incident trends, MTTR, MTTD, backlog and recurring failures.
* Support weekly and monthly service reviews with concise reporting covering operational performance, risks, actions and dependencies.
* Keep operational controls, runbooks, knowledge articles, support procedures and audit evidence current and ensure agreed processes are followed.
* Support change and release governance through risk assessments, readiness checks, validation evidence and post-change monitoring.

### **Problem management and continual improvement**

* Lead technical investigations into recurring incidents and contribute to high-quality root cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Maintain and prioritise a service-improvement backlog using incident trends, monitoring gaps and operational risks.
* Identify opportunities to automate health checks, alert responses, reporting, housekeeping and repetitive support activities.
* Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, dashboards and early detection to reduce customer impact and operational effort.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure and validate that improvements deliver sustainable results.

### **Team and stakeholder coordination**

* Provide technical guidance, work-allocation support and knowledge sharing for application support engineers.
* Collaborate with Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners.
* Escalate risks, capacity concerns, vendor dependencies and unresolved service issues through agreed governance channels.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Technical knowledge and experience**

* You have **7–10 years' experience** in Telecom IT, Oracle BSS or enterprise CRM application operations.
* You have at least **5 years' hands-on Oracle Siebel CRM production support experience**.
* You have strong knowledge of Siebel CRM architecture, server components, configuration, Workflows, eScript, Business Services, EAI, Integration Objects, inbound/outbound web services and Open UI troubleshooting.
* You understand Siebel administration, including component health, tasks, sessions, logs, parameters and environment checks.
* You have strong Oracle SQL/PLSQL skills for data analysis, troubleshooting and performance investigation.
* You can use Unix/Linux and Shell scripting for log analysis, health checks, housekeeping and operational automation.
* You understand telecom order management, product catalogue, customer and service-request flows.
* You can troubleshoot integrations involving FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic and downstream systems.
* You have hands-on experience with one or more observability tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Splunk, Kibana, Grafana or Zabbix.
* You understand cloud, containers and Kubernetes/OKE operations, including pod health, logs, events, resource usage and restart validation.
* You have awareness of CI/CD, configuration control and rollback principles in an application-operations environment.
* You have experience supporting business-critical services and resolving complex production incidents within SLA.

### **Service management and collaboration**

* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Request management.
* You have working knowledge of the ITIL framework and production-operations controls.
* You have experience with SLA/KPI tracking, service reporting and operational governance.
* You can contribute to effective RCA, risk management and continual service improvement.
* You can coordinate effectively with stakeholders, vendors and cross-functional teams.
* You communicate technical and operational information clearly in writing and verbally.
* Experience delivering measurable improvements through automation, monitoring or continual-service-improvement initiatives is important.

### **Preferred qualifications and experience**

* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Exposure to Kubernetes/OKE, cloud operations, DevOps/SRE practices and enterprise observability tools.
* Experience with telecom order management and Oracle BSS integrations.

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What’s in it for you**
------------------------

The opportunity to work hands-on with business-critical **Oracle Siebel CRM and Oracle BSS services**.Exposure to complex, cross-platform telecom operations spanning FMW/AIA, OSM, BRM, WebLogic, databases, infrastructure and networks.Opportunities to contribute to service reliability through **SRE practices, observability, automation and continual service improvement**.Experience influencing improvements measured through availability, SLA compliance, MTTR, MTTD, incident recurrence and change stability.Collaboration across Service Management, Business, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, Oracle and other support partners.

* Observability, monitoring and early-detection techniques across enterprise applications.

* SRE and continual-service-improvement practices focused on reliability and reducing operational effort.

Our mission is to deliver secure, resilient, and high\-performance datacenter and cloud solutions for global operations.


Organized into four teams, Global Systems Engineering, Unix Engineering, Windows Engineering, and Database Engineering, this group drives operational excellence, security, high availability, compliance, and continuous improvement across our technology estate.


By championing automation, standardization, and proactive monitoring, and by working closely with application, security, and business teams, we ensure our environments are robust, stable, and scalable. Through this collaborative approach and a relentless focus on modernization, Jefferies’ infrastructure remains agile and adaptable, ready to meet the evolving needs of our global business.


**Job Summary**

Jefferies is seeking a dynamic, hands\-on, and strategic Senior Vice President (SVP), Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms (Pune). This executive technical leader will lead automation, operations, and modernization of Jefferies’ platform stack, with a focus on critical platform domains: databases, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, and Unix/Windows server infrastructure. Based in Pune, India, the SVP will lead the Pune CIP team and be accountable for technical excellence, operational resilience, and end\-to\-end Pune led delivery supporting the US, EMEA and APAC estate. This role reports to the Head of GCC, Pune (primary) and the Global Head of Core Infrastructure Platforms, Jersey City (secondary).


This is not a pure management or “middle\-layer” role. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on domain expert who remains technically current, acts as a trusted escalation point and decision\-maker, and independently resolves complex infrastructure and operational challenges rather than simply escalating them.


Success in this role comes from earning the trust of engineers and global business stakeholders through demonstrated technical mastery, incident command, and the delivery of solutions that enable strategic business outcomes. The position requires deep technical expertise paired with proven people leadership to build, mentor, and scale high\-performing teams supporting 24/7 capital markets operations.  



**Key Responsibilities**

* **Global Platform Leadership:** partner with global leads on the vision, engineering standards, and operational governance for Jefferies’ core infrastructure stack: database, virtualization, storage, backup, compute, Unix/Linux, and Windows server platforms, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* **Local Management of the Infrastructure Team:** direct managerial responsibilities for Infrastructure Technology team members located in the Jefferies Pune office (Networks, Telecom, Digital Workplace, Cloud, CIP, Service Delivery).
* **Modernization \& Cloud/Hybrid Adoption:** Drive modernization, cloud/hybrid adoption, automation\-first delivery, and standardization across all domains, balancing operational excellence with innovation and optimization. Lead strategic integration and optimal workload placement between on\-premises and cloud resources, as business and regulatory requirements permit.
* **Hands\-on Technical Escalation:** Serve as the final point of escalation and technical incident lead during major outages, performance, or security incidents. Analyze real\-time symptoms, ask the right diagnostic questions, and guide teams towards root\-cause resolution.
* **Solution Delivery:** Architect and deliver practical, high\-impact solutions for business and application teams, actively collaborating with CIO leadership, BU leads, and local metro SVPs/VPs worldwide.
* **Operational Resilience** : Own and continuously improve resilience, high\-availability, recovery, and compliance strategies across the global platform estate.
* **Global Team Development:** Partner with global leads in NYC, London, and HK to cultivate a high\-performing, distributed team of engineers and architects, primarily based in India. You will mentor leaders and engineers, promote end\-to\-end ownership, and develop problem\-solving capability.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Partner with business units, application teams, and senior platform leaders to align technical priorities, communicate platform direction, and enable local\-global business outcomes.
* **Technical Standards \& Documentation:** Author, maintain, and enforce robust operational standards, SLAs, playbooks, and knowledge base for platform operations and incident response.
* **Post\-Incident Review \& Learning:** Lead technical post\-mortems and deep\-dives, drive remediation, and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.
* **Regulatory \& Risk Alignment:** Execute robust security, compliance, vulnerability management, and audit readiness for mission\-critical infrastructure in a highly regulated financial services environment.

**Mandatory Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Experience:**
	+ 15\+ years in IT infrastructure/platform engineering and operations, with at least 5 years in global technical leadership (financial services or complex enterprise IT preferred).
	+ Proven recent, hands\-on experience with at least three of: database platforms (SQL/Oracle/etc), virtualization (VMware/Hyper\-V/KVM, Nutanix), storage (SAN/NAS), backup/DR, Unix/Linux, and Windows server engineering and operations.
	+ Track record as a solution owner, not just a conduit, able to independently architect and deliver technical outcomes in critical environments.
* **Core Competencies:**
	+ Deep technical expertise, able to lead troubleshooting, ask the right questions, synthesize technical indicators, and command resolution during platform issues and outages.
	+ Domain credibility, regarded by engineers and senior IT partners as the go\-to technical escalation contact.
	+ Record of driving platform modernization, cloud/hybrid/cloud adoption, automation, and cost/risk optimization.
	+ Strong foundation in regulatory, compliance, and operational risk management for infrastructure.
	+ Executive presence, able to command trust in both technical and business forums, and partner with C\-levels, application owners, and metro engineering leaders.
	+ Outstanding stakeholder management, communication, prioritization, and conflict resolution skills, on both local (India) and global scales.
	+ Experience designing and enforcing technical standards, SLAs, and incident management frameworks.
* **Certifications (optional, but valued):**Recognized certifications (RHCE, MCSE, VMware, Nutanix, NetApp, AWS/Azure/GCP, ITIL, etc.)

The SVP delivers a world\-class platform that serves as a resilient, secure, continuously modernizing backbone for all Jefferies business applications, across on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
